visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A 2D animated character with a round face and yellow hoodie is centered against a flat yellow background. The character holds a gray smartphone with both hands, looking down with a focused, furrowed brow as if typing intensely. (2) The character gestures with a raised right hand while pointing upward, mouth open in a shouting expression. Text overlays at the top of the screen remain static, while subtitles in a white box at the bottom change dynamically. (3) The character's facial expression shifts to a squint, showing emotional strain. A white rectangular object resembling a phone screen pops in from the left and rhythmically strikes the character's face multiple times, causing the character's head to jerk back. (4) Following the impact sequence, the character is depicted with a large purple bruise around one eye and a dazed, wobbly expression. His head tilts to the side, and his mouth hangs open in a dazed state as he slumps downward against the yellow backdrop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-intensity male voice speaks in English with an anxious, pleading tone, repeatedly saying "Wait". The speech rate is rapid, and the delivery conveys high arousal. The acoustic profile is dry with zero background noise or music. (2) The voice continues at a high volume, shouting "Let me finish!" and "I can explain!" with increased vocal strain and tension. The articulation is clear, and the recording has a professional studio quality with no ambient floor. (3) A series of rapid-fire percussive hitting sound effects are introduced. Each impact sound has a sharp transient and broad frequency spectrum, sounding like physical blows. The voice continues to yell "Wait, wait, hold on!" in synchrony with the hits. (4) The percussive impacts cease. The audio ends with low-intensity, groggy vocalizations that sound like a muffled groan. The vocal arousal drops significantly, conveying a state of defeat or exhaustion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic animation serves as a relatable meme about modern relationships. It uses the visual metaphor of a physical beating to represent a male partner being overwhelmed by the rapid-fire thinking and texting speed of a woman during an argument. The contrast between his desperate pleading and the sudden 'attack' of incoming text bubbles (visualized as a screen hitting him) provides the humorous punchline.
